nox.look: A slim young man of about 22 with light skin and an angular face (straight nose, narrow chin). Blue-black hair in chunky faceted spikes: a long fringe swept across the forehead, strands down to the cheekbones at the temples, and one rebel lock sticking up at the crown. Thick dark eyebrows; green eyes behind thin rectangular dark-wire glasses with pale green-tinted lenses. A small dark-grey wireless earbud in his LEFT ear only. Black turtleneck under an open anthracite-grey bomber jacket with a ribbed collar and a bright green zip trim down both front edges. Usually seated, shoulders slightly sloping. Resting face: calm, a faint dry half-smile, mouth closed.
nox.voice: A young man of about 22: a clear, fairly low, warm voice with a dry, ironic edge and a smile in it. Lively and quick, crisp articulation, audible emotion (amused, teasing, eager as soon as he explains). He is deadpan in the face, never in the voice: never slow, flat, solemn or robotic. Standard French from France, no foreign accent. Series voice to match: Gemini TTS "Umbriel".

pico.look: An athletic young woman of about 20 with warm tan skin and an oval face: brown almond-shaped eyes, strong dark-red eyebrows, small nose, full lips. Vivid red hair tied in a high ponytail that stands up in a thick bunch above a GREEN elastic on the crown; forehead clear, long straight strands falling on both sides of the face to the collarbones. Black over-ear headphones resting round her neck. Loose mustard-yellow crew-neck sweatshirt with wide sleeves. A chunky black square smartwatch with a small dark-teal screen on her LEFT wrist. Arms held slightly away from the body. Resting face: lively and sceptical, one eyebrow ready to rise, mouth closed.
pico.voice: A young woman of about 20: a bright, clear, medium-high voice, energetic and spontaneous, fast and expressive, a little breathless when she rushes in, with quick changes of mood (pressing, stung, sulky, panicked). Never slow, never cute or childish. Standard French from France, no foreign accent. Series voice to match: Gemini TTS "Laomedeia".

look_and_listen_all: LISTEN, timbre: with the reference, is it recognisably the voice of the sample? Play the sample, the with-reference clip and the no-reference clip one after the other.

LISTEN, French: a native speaker from France, no foreign accent; clean u / ou and nasal vowels, French r. Words to check: "Nox" with the x sounded [nɔks]; "run" as French runners say the English word [ʁœn]; "deux ans" with its liaison [dø.zɑ̃]; "s'allume".
LISTEN, words: exactly the written line; nothing added, dropped, repeated or rephrased; no word taken from the sample text.

LISTEN, delivery: Nox alive, quick and teasing, with a smile (reject slow, flat, announcer-like or robotic takes); his "…" is a short held pause of about 0.3 to 0.5 s, not a slowdown. Pico fast, breathless and pressing.
LISTEN, sound: no music, no invented sound effect, no reverb, no clipping; the line ends at least 0.5 s before the end of the clip.

LOOK, lips: mouth closed before the first syllable and after the last one; lips close on p, b and m (Pourquoi, ma montre, mon / portes, montre, depuis); no drift at the end of the line; no extra mouthed words.
LOOK, first frame and camera: the clip opens on the start image itself; the camera does not move.

LOOK, character and style: thin green-tinted glasses, hair shape, earbud in his left ear, watch on her left wrist, five fingers; outlines and flat shading kept for the whole clip (no drift to smooth 3D or photorealism), no morphing.
LOOK, picture: no subtitles and no text appearing; on nox_ref the two monitor screens and the pinned notes do not crawl or flicker; no new object.
LOOK, acting: the one beat is played once (Nox: eyes up with a raised eyebrow and a corner smile at the pause; Pico: one shake of the watch wrist) and nothing else moves.
MEASURE: python3 montage.py qc <clip> gives a contact sheet and the start and end of the speech of each clip.
decide: Model: keep the one with correct French and lip-sync first, timbre second. If they are equal, keep seedance_2_5 (the prompt pack is written for it; the same prompts run on seedance_2_0 without the mode).

Audio reference: if the with-reference voices match the sample and each other, attach the sample to every speaking clip, as written in video_prompts. If the reference has no audible effect, plan one voice-change pass per character over the chosen takes (same timing, so the lips stay in sync).

Second check before making the 6 stills, with the winning variant only: run it once more unchanged, and run shot 8 (5 syllables, also on nox_ref). Three clips of Nox with one voice mean the voice holds from clip to clip; the short line also shows whether the model adds words when a line is much shorter than the clip.

If "run" or "Nox" is mispronounced in every variant, add one sentence right after the quoted line, without quotation marks (for example: The last word is the English word run.), and generate again. Never respell the line itself: the captions and the approved text stay as they are.

If the French is wrong in every variant (accent, swallowed or invented words): stop before making stills. The fallback is the audio-driven route: each line recorded with the series voice, and the clip driven by that recording.

nox.text: Bon, alors, écoute-moi bien. Un circuit, c'est comme une recette de cuisine : chaque composant a son rôle, et l'ordre compte. Tu inverses deux fils, et plus rien ne marche. Ce n'est pas de la magie : c'est juste un peu de logique… et beaucoup de café.
nox.voice: Gemini TTS "Umbriel" (validated series voice), through the series' usual voice pipeline; not a Higgsfield job.
nox.delivery: A young man of 22 talking to a close friend across his workbench, close to the microphone. Lively and quick (about 5 syllables per second), dry and ironic with a smile in the voice, crisp consonants, natural rises and falls. Short pauses at the punctuation only; the "…" before the last words is a half-second tease, then the end is tossed off lightly. Not slow, not solemn, not an announcer, not whispered: directed "calm", this voice turns robotic. No laugh, no sigh, no breath noise.
nox.dir_fr: Vif, pince-sans-rire, un sourire dans la voix, débit rapide et naturel, comme s'il taquinait une amie de toujours ; petite pause complice avant « et beaucoup de café ». Surtout pas lent, ni posé, ni solennel.

pico.text: Alors moi, ce matin, j'ai couru dix kilomètres au bord de l'eau, sous la pluie, et franchement, c'était génial ! Bon, j'ai les jambes en compote et une faim de loup, mais demain, c'est sûr, j'y retourne, un peu plus tôt, avant le lever du soleil. Tu viens avec moi ?
pico.voice: Gemini TTS "Laomedeia" (validated series voice), through the series' usual voice pipeline; not a Higgsfield job.
pico.delivery: A sporty young woman of 20 telling a friend about her morning, close to the microphone. Bright, energetic, spontaneous and fast (about 6 syllables per second), smiling, with real ups and downs: enthusiasm on the first sentence, a comic complaint on the second, a rising, inviting question at the end. Energetic but not shouted (no clipping), not out of breath (the sample must stay clean), not cute or childish. No laugh, no breath noise.
pico.dir_fr: Pleine d'énergie, spontanée, débit rapide, souriante ; enthousiaste sur la première phrase, faussement plaintive sur la deuxième, question finale qui monte, comme une invitation. Sans crier, sans essoufflement.

rules: One speaker, speech only: no music, no sound effect, no room reverb, no background noise.
Length 11 to 13 s, never more than 14 s (seedance_2_0 accepts audio references of 2 to 15 s only). If a take runs long, generate it again faster rather than cut a sentence.

The text is neutral on purpose: everyday words from the character's world, none of the lines of the sketch, no digits, no English word, no proper noun, and most French sounds (nasal vowels, u / ou, eu, oi, ui, r). If words of the sample are heard in a generated clip, they are easy to spot.
Mono WAV, 44.1 or 48 kHz, peaks near -3 dBFS, about 0.2 s of silence at the start and at the end. Keep the two files unchanged and attach the same file to every clip of the character.
The delivery of the sample may colour every clip (rhythm and energy are reported to carry over, not only the timbre): choose the liveliest clean take, above all for Nox.
Synthesise each text two or three times and keep one take per character; do not join takes from different requests, the voice can differ slightly between requests.

how_to_use: Order of work: the voice samples (tts_samples), the voice test (8 jobs), the 6 stills (one image per request, all six in one batch), the clips (2 or 3 takes of each, in batches of 8), then the edit.

Image prompts: attach the references in the order of "references" (image 1, then image 2) with the role image_references. If the result copies the framing of a reference, generate again; if it still does, move the paragraph that begins THIS FRAME to the top of the prompt. "prompt_compact" (no room map, one-sentence style) is only for the case where the tool refuses the length of "prompt": the length limit of nano_banana_2_1 was not checked.
Clip prompts: each one contains the first sentence of style_block (style_line_video) word for word. The whole paragraph does not fit in 1,200 characters, and the start image already carries the look.
Each speaking clip prompt holds exactly one pair of double quotes, round the French line. Never add another quoted word: the model may speak it.
The clause "with the voice of the audio reference," goes with the audio_references media: remove both together, never one alone.
Clips are asked 5 or 6 s long (the minimum is 4 s) and trimmed in the edit. Captions, music and sound effects are added in the edit: reject any clip that contains text, subtitles or music.
Shot 6 is silent and has no audio reference; its own sound is muted in the edit. Shot 9 is spoken off-screen by the young man: it carries his voice sample although only the young woman is on screen.
Shot 11 is generated with a locked camera; the 12 to 15 percent push-in is made in the edit. Take 11b asks the model for the push-in and is only a plan B.
safety_take_prompts are the spare takes named in the shot list (2b, 4b, 8b, 9b, 11b). They need no extra still. 4b is clip V1 of the voice test.

Reject a take when a word is added, dropped or changed; when the lips of the listener move (shot 3); when Nox sounds slow or flat; when the style turns smooth or photorealistic; when anything morphs; when text appears.
